answer: A cheap fleet looks solid until you stress the hollow middle: force each new identity to stake work that only pays after peers attest across a measured delta of successful epochs. Reputations freeze like a glacier—slow to form, costly to fake—so multiplying socks burns capital without unlocking trust or reward weight. Require bonded attest chains keyed to unique challenge seeds; orphan identities with no peer countersignatures stay unpaid and drop from panels.
